# CodeSphere

> A free developer reference: programming languages, frameworks, libraries and dev tools, learning roadmaps, software design and architecture guides, plus practical guides on communication and social skills.

All pages are server-rendered HTML and free to read and cite. Base URL: https://codes-sphere.vercel.app

## Languages, frameworks and tools

- [Programming Language & Framework Catalog](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/): Explore programming languages and frameworks in one organized developer reference.
- [All Frameworks by Language](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/frameworks): Browse popular frameworks organized by programming language.
- [Tech Stack A–Z](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/tech-stack): An A–Z index of 550+ libraries, frameworks and developer tools, each with a one-line summary.
- [History of Programming Languages](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/TimeLine): Timeline of major programming languages and their origins.

## Roadmaps

- [Software Engineer Roadmap](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/swe-roadmap): Guided path through core software engineering skills and topics.
- [AI Engineer Roadmap](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/ai-roadmap): A practical roadmap to become an AI engineer from fundamentals to deployment.
- [Machine Learning Roadmap](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/ml-roadmap): Step-by-step learning roadmap for machine learning engineers.
- [Developer Essential Skills](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/developer-essential-skills): Key skills every modern developer should build for long-term growth.

## Architecture and engineering

- [RAG Architecture Guide](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/rag): Interactive guide to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval, and grounded inference.
- [System Design Reference](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/system-design): Core system design concepts: scalability, caching, and distributed systems.
- [Software Design Patterns](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/design-patterns): Reference for creational, structural, and behavioral design patterns.
- [Design Principles](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/design-principles): Essential software design principles for maintainable and scalable systems.
- [DevOps & Infrastructure Guide](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/devops): DevOps tools, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure best practices.
- [Project Checklist](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/project-checklist): Comprehensive checklist to plan, build, and ship software projects.

## Design and motion

- [Design Styles Guide](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/design-styles): Explore modern design styles and their practical use cases.
- [Motion Design Guide](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/motion-design): Motion design principles, techniques, and implementation ideas.
- [Animations Guide](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/animations-guide): Practical guide to UI and web animations for developers.
- [Vibe Explorer](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/vibe-explorer): Explore and discover coding vibes, genres, and creative themes.

## Communication and social skills

- [Handle Insults & Bullies Like a Pro](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/handle-insults): Exact scripts for backhanded compliments, interruptions, credit theft, insults, passive-aggressive jabs and other disrespect.
- [Social Intelligence Guide](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/social-intelligence): Develop communication, empathy, and interpersonal effectiveness.
- [Civic Sense Guide](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/civic-sense): Civic awareness and practical social responsibility insights.

## Other

- [Business Timeline](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/business-timeline): How major business models evolved from industrial manufacturing to AI-driven companies.
- [Sitemap](https://codes-sphere.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
